recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit core only if active core Condition text starts referring to the extension incorrectly; substantive changes to condition-diseaseCourse or condition-course should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-20358 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Patient Care issue asking for a way to represent acute versus chronic disease course on Condition. The accepted resolution avoided changing Condition.clinicalStatus or adding a core element, recommended pre-coordinated Condition.code where appropriate, and approved a standard 0..1 CodeableConcept disease-course extension with an example binding to SNOMED CT descendants of 288524001 Courses.
initial_application: Core commit b6d04cc87c50a0fb4bc42f0a97fa3daabdc3f522 (GF#20358 Add Condition extension for disease-course) applied the decision by adding the Condition disease-course extension support, source/condition/valueset-condition-course.xml, and SNOMED source content. Later core history converted the artifact into a discrete condition-diseaseCourse StructureDefinition before it was moved out of core.
additional_context: Core commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed Condition-specific extensions, including condition-diseaseCourse and condition-course, from R5 core source. Current core still builds Condition, but no active core condition-diseaseCourse StructureDefinition or condition-course ValueSet remains. The FHIR Extension Pack currently defines http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/condition-diseaseCourse on Condition as 0..1 CodeableConcept with an example binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/condition-course, and that ValueSet filters SNOMED CT by concept is-a 288524001. Zulip and Patient Care minutes confirm the extension interpretation and reveal no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. An empty external-repo audit commit was published because the requested standard extension exists in the external extension-pack source of truth and re-adding it to active core source would be the wrong build-scope ownership.
